clips.title: The story
paras: Bandarion Keep is a fortified redoubt associated with Tyr's Watch, nestled in the western reaches of Tirisfal Glades near the Whispering Forest. Named in honor of Garek Bandarion, the outpost serves as an isolated bulwark amidst lingering threats across the woodland frontier. Its defenders contend with everything from hostile coastal murlocs to roving zealots and unstable undead.

Situated near the secluded Whispering Forest in western Tirisfal Glades, Bandarion Keep stands as a solitary sentinel for the Forsaken. Named after Garek Bandarion, this stronghold is closely tied to Tyr's Watch. Quartermasters like Jorin Croge work diligently to keep the garrison supplied despite its remote and challenging position far from the bustling courtyards of the Undercity.
